title: Simple abelian variety over its ground field
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $C/k$ be an abelian variety [def-sc-abelian-variety], with its group-scheme structure [def-sc-group-scheme]. Say that $C$ is $k$-simple if $0<\dim C$ and there is no abelian variety $B/k$ and closed immersion of $k$-group schemes $i:B\to C$ with $0<\dim B<\dim C$. Thus simplicity is over $k$, not geometric simplicity.

source.place: Chapter I, §10, Decomposing abelian varieties, printed p.42, immediately before Proposition 10.1; the positive-dimension convention is explicit in lem-sfb-simple-isogeny-decomposition.
